content.question: What is the key difference between stochastic and batch gradient descent?
options: BGD updates the parameters after the entire dataset iteration, while SGD updates them after a random mini-batch.
SGD updates the parameters only after the entire dataset iteration, while BGD uses mini-batches.
BGD never converges, while SGD always finds the global minimum.
SGD can only be applied to low-dimensional problems, meanwhile BGD is applicable to high-dimensional problems.
content.answer: BGD updates the parameters after the entire dataset iteration, while SGD updates them after a random mini-batch.
